Requirements

  • To begin A long lost treasure with Sterling you must be Level 10.
  • A rope and a shovel (or equivalents).
  • To begin Burning Heat with Emiliana you must be Level 12.

Method

An ancient enemy

Talk to Lizzie in south part of Targuna. Head north and enter the Hidden Lizard Temple through a staircase here (31936, 31863, 7). Go one level lower and defeat the Lizard Commander in this room here (31941, 31947, 9). Enter the Magic Forcefield to the north of the room to return to Targuna and talk to Lizzie. Go to the depot and go up through the stairs to talk to Camilla. You will receive 2 platinum coins and 1500 experience points.

A long lost treasure

Speak to Sterling, you will find him at the west side of Targuna. Travel to Aragonia using the sea turtle. In Aragonia kill at least 20 pirates and collect 10 tortoise eggs.The eggs are scattered around the island and you just need to Use them. Then talk to Morla in the south cave of Argonia (33516, 32747, 7). You will receive an Old Treasure Map. Return to Targuna and talk to Sterling. You receive 3000 experience points and a mark appears on the map. Go to the mark here (31948, 31924, 7), use a shovel and grab the Adventurer Backpack from the chest.

Burning Heat

Talk to Emiliana in the room above the training dummy in Targuna. Accept the mission and go to the room above. Enter the Energy Portal to get to the Crimson Court. Talk to Emiliana again and say "mission". Descend to through the Crimson Court until you reach the Magic Forcefield here (32423, 32653, 14) to fight Herald of Fire. Before reaching the forcefield, there are fire walls that can be disabled by pressing the pressure plates that are on the sides of the dungeon, but you can just cross through the fire by taking burning damage. Enter the forcefield, stand on the Stone Tile in the center of the room and press the lever. You will be teleported to a boss fight with Herald of Fire. Defeat him and enter the purple energy portal to exit the dungeon, then talk to Emiliana again. You will receive 5000 experience points and Bunch of Turnips. Give the Bunch of Turnips to the ram in the west side of (31926, 31896, 7) Targuna in order to obtain the Reliable Ram mount and the A reliable Friend achievement.

In case you lost the Bunch of Turnips you can talk to Emiliana and pay 1000 gold to receive them again.

Transcripts

An ancient enemy

Player: hi
Lizzie: Hey there. I need your help urgently, we have to save Targuna!
Player: save
Lizzie: Finally! I need your help here adventurer.
Lizzie: My research suggests there is an ancient lizard group, which poses a real threat to us here on Targuna. We need to put a stop to that NOW! Are you ready?
Player: yes
Lizzie: I finally found someone to help me, seriously thank you!
Lizzie: Though we must start now, the lizards won't wait for us! I've marked the temple entrance on your map.

Targuna Quest When talking to Lizzie

Player: hi
Lizzie: There you are! How's our mission doing?
Player: mission
Lizzie: Thank you for finally putting an end to this ancient lizard clan hidden inside the temple here on Targuna.
Lizzie: Make sure to visit Camilla at her office, if you haven't already. And if you're in for more trouble then I'd suggest talking to Sterling and Emiliana.

Targuna Quest When talking to Lizzie

Player: hi
Camilla: Greetings my friend!
Player: mission
Camilla: What mission? The hidden temple?! Ohh my, they were hiding inside the temple ruins on Targuna? How many you say?! How could we be so blind ...
Camilla: Now tell me Player, did you put an end to their commander?
Player: yes
Camilla: Ohh ... Wow, these lizards ... I'm glad you could put an end to it, I don't want to think about what could've happened if this problem had gone under our radar.
Camilla: Thank you! There's a gift as a sign of gratitude for all you've done. I'm sure you'll find some interesting things in Aurelia's shop.

Targuna Quest When talking to Camilla

A long lost treasure

Player: hi
Sterling: Ahoyyy there, you might be just who I'm looking for. I need some help on an adventure ...
Player: adventure
Sterling: I do have something that's been bothering me as of late. On the closest island, Aragonia, some pirates crash landed.
Sterling: Ever since they arrived, these pirates have been wreaking havoc on the surrounding islands and capturing wild turtles, including Targuna itself. Could you help me and this island by taking care of this threat with that?
Player: yes
Sterling: Thank you adventurer! In order to travel to Aragonia just sit down on the back of my turtle Matilda here and enjoy the ride - free of charge of course!

Targuna Quest When talking to Sterling

Player: hi
Morla: Oh hello, I wasn't expecting anyone so soon ... What has Sterling told you?
Player: mission
Morla: Yes, I indeed have a mission for you though I bet Sterling might have already told you about it.
Morla: Please take care of these pirates and collect and save my eggs around the island, did you already complete your objective?
Player: yes
Morla: Thank you so much for taking care of these pirates and collecting these precious eggs. Here take this as a sign of gratitude, I found it laying around in the sand near a rock, it might be useful once you've decrypted it.
Morla: I bet Sterling can help you with that, now go and see where this map leads you, take care adventurer Player!

Targuna Quest When talking to Morla

Player: hi
Sterling: Ahoyyy there, back from your quest I see.
Player: quest
Sterling: Oh, would you look at that, you really helped us out here. I'm glad to see you alive and well!
Sterling: Did Morla hand you anything for your service?
Player: yes
Sterling: Thank you for bringing me that map. If I see that correctly the X that marks the spot seems to be here on Targuna.
Sterling: Let me mark it for you, don't wait too long to grab it. I'd be a shame if you were too late ...

Targuna Quest When talking to Sterling

Burning Heat

Player: hi
Emiliana: Hey, I really need your help on an important mission urgently.
Player: mission
Emiliana: Ah yes, finally someone's ready for a real challenge. Are you willing to help me defeat the yet unknown danger inside the portal upstairs?
Player: yes
Emiliana: Great! Here's what I need you to do: Go upstairs, open the door and walk through the portal, I will hand you more information once we're inside.

Targuna Quest

Player: hi
Talking to Emiliana
Emiliana: Great that you're here, we need to move quickly!
Player: mission
Emiliana: Right, so I gathered some information. We currently are at an upper level of the Crimson Court, down below are at least two more areas, though I haven't scouted anything related to the Herald yet.
Emiliana: Your task is to do exactly that, find out where the Herald resides and defeat him to end his reign of terror once and for all.

Targuna Quest After entering the portal.

Player: hi
Emiliana: Hey adventurer Player! Is it just me or has it gotten hotter in here, anyways ...
Emiliana: Tell me about your mission.
Player: mission
Emiliana: I can feel it already, the Herald has been defeated by your very own hands.
Emiliana: I can't tell you how happy I am that my wicked portal won't be the beginning of a tragedy. Here this is for you, take it as a sign of gratitude for your hard work. Would you like to have it now?
Player: yes
Emiliana: Well there you go, let me gift you this as form of my gratitude for your help. Maybe the lonely ram on Targuna wouldn't mind taking a bite or two ...
Emiliana: Anyways, I'll see you around.
